conversation.emptyHistory: Ask for something and it happens in your session. Try naming a track, a time range, or what you want it to sound like.

responseCompleteness.mayBeIncomplete: Part of this response did not arrive, so what you see may be incomplete.

toolActivity.awaitingResponse: Sesh AI is working on your request.

producerPrompt.inputPlaceholder: Describe what you want to do in your session

refusal.promptTextTooLong: That prompt is too long to send. Shorten it and try again.
refusal.transportUnavailable: The panel could not reach the extension, so nothing was sent. Your prompt is still here.
refusal.notSent: The prompt could not be sent. It is still here, so you can try again.

connectionStatus.closeTheOtherReaperInstance: Another REAPER instance is holding this session. Close it and this panel will connect — it will not keep retrying on its own.
connectionStatus.signInAgain: Your sign-in is no longer valid. Sign in again to reconnect.
connectionStatus.failedAttempts: Failed attempts since the last connection: {{attempts}}

byCode.stage_creation_failed: Audio streaming could not be set up, so there is nothing to monitor remotely yet. Your session is untouched.
byCode.participant_token_issuance_failed: Audio streaming could not be authorised, so there is nothing to monitor remotely yet. Your session is untouched.

confirmation.heading: Approve this action?
confirmation.riskNotReported: Sesh AI did not say how risky this is, so the risk shown above is the extension's own cautious assumption rather than an assessment of this action.
confirmation.detailsUnavailable: No further detail arrived with this request.
confirmation.descriptionIncomplete: Part of this request did not arrive, so the description above may not cover everything this action would do.
confirmation.timeElapsed: The time to answer has run out. Waiting to hear what happened.
confirmation.windowExplanation: If this is not answered in time, the action is cancelled and nothing in your session changes.
confirmation.answerSubmitted: Your answer has been sent. Waiting for it to be confirmed.
confirmation.answerNotSent: Your answer did not leave the panel, so nothing has been answered yet. Try again.

resolution.expired: The time to answer ran out, so the action was cancelled.
resolution.unknown: That request is no longer waiting for an answer.
resolution.nothingWasChanged: Nothing in your session was changed.
resolution.answeredOnThePhone: It was answered on your phone.
resolution.answeredElsewhere: It was answered on another device.
resolution.approvalDidNotTakeEffect: You approved it, but it had already been settled the other way, so your approval did not take effect.
resolution.rejectionDidNotTakeEffect: You rejected it, but it had already been settled the other way, so your rejection did not take effect.
resolution.verdictDidNotTakeEffect: Your answer arrived too late to count, so it did not take effect.

scriptDownload.explanation: Sesh AI wrote this script for you to read and run yourself. The extension does not run it.
scriptDownload.expired: This download link has expired. Ask Sesh AI for the script again to get a fresh one.

streamIngest.explanation: Paste these into ReaCast to send your session audio out.
streamIngest.expired: These streaming details have expired. Ask Sesh AI to set up streaming again.
streamIngest.reissued: These details were refreshed. Use the stream key shown here.
